question: A thin, non-conducting rod of finite length $2L$ is placed along the z-axis, centered at the origin (from $z=-L$ to $z=L$). It carries a uniform linear charge density $+λ$. A short electric dipole of moment $\vec{p} = p\hat{j}$ is placed on the positive x-axis at a distance $x$ from the origin. What is the magnitude of the torque experienced by the dipole?

options.A: Zero, due to the symmetric placement of the rod.
